en.headline: AFCD starts four-month sweep for unattended dogs
en.dek: The department said it will first go to places with previous attacks or gatherings of stray dogs.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said on Thursday it has begun a new phase of special operations to catch unattended dogs, and will keep the work going for four months if needed.

A spokesman said officers will first go to higher-risk places where dogs have attacked passers-by, or where stray dogs gather, in order to protect public safety. Caught dogs will be checked for a microchip and a valid licence. The department will contact the keeper from the registration record, check lost-dog reports, and prosecute the keeper if there is enough evidence. It will work with police on joint operations when required.

Dogs whose keepers cannot be found will be observed by animal-management staff and a veterinary surgeon. If they are healthy and gentle in temperament, they will be passed to partner animal-welfare groups for neutering and adoption, the spokesman said. The department will not return unowned dogs directly to the community, because of the risk to public safety.
The spokesman asked keepers to meet their responsibilities. The department did not give a target number of dogs for the operation.

zh.headline: 漁護署展開四個月捕捉無人看管狗隻行動
zh.dek: 署方說會優先到曾有狗隻襲擊途人，或有流浪狗聚集的地點執法。
body: 漁農自然護理署星期四公布，即日起展開新一階段特別行動，加強捕捉無人看管狗隻，未來四個月會視乎情況繼續進行。
發言人說，行動會優先到曾有狗隻襲擊途人，以及有流浪狗聚集的高風險地點，以保障公眾安全。捕獲後會檢查狗隻有沒有植入晶片及有效牌照，按登記資料聯絡畜養人，並核對報失紀錄；如有足夠證據，會檢控畜養人。有需要時會與警方聯合執法。
找不到畜養人的狗隻，會由動物管理中心人員及獸醫師觀察。確認身體健康、性情溫馴後，會轉交伙伴動物福利機構絕育並安排領養。發言人強調，為免造成公共安全風險，不會把無人畜養的狗隻直接放回社區。
發言人呼籲畜養人履行責任。署方沒有公布今次行動的捕捉目標數目。
